"the ten cardinal rules" -- this is from Ari Kiev's book

man coached everyone from L/S PM's to US Olympic athletes

I share it bc what u see at the highest level, couldnt be more simple and basic.

-"what emotion am I feeling right now"
-"how do I react to stress"
-"out of all the possible styles, what works for my temperament"

this is what waits for u at the top of the mountain

u may as well start grappling with it now

and u may as well stop asking the world -- or asking LLMs -- questions which can only be answered by the man in the mirror...
